collision.force_interpretation: Raw simulated PhysX callback vectors, collider convention retained; native source declares impulse Ns and divides by1/240s into N. Sign, magnitude/calibration and actual physical contact force are not independently validated. Never sum callback into tensor forces.

geometry.authored_input_material_and_hull_SAT_cro: Both present at sampled49.9000/49.904167/49.908333/49.9125s; witness triangles saved, not an attached cooked shape collision-time certificate.
geometry.interpretation: Contact coordinates are consistent with actual transformed high cover input material; old1.178m whole-CAD height is inapplicable to this open-cover pose. This audit does not require a pure convex-fill-only explanation, and does not certify exact effective cooked geometry or exclude millimetre-scale input/cooked differences.
geometry.whole_robot_scope: 11 collision-bearing rigid links reconstructed from source input meshes and recorded joints via CPU URDF FK; all transforms/AABBs saved. No live native link pose/cooked shape buffer readback.

public_view_review.viewed_exact_current_JPEGs: D22/23/24 side+wrist, six original640×480 q60 high JPEGs, copied unchanged. D24 also had previous D23 and first bilateral D7 wrist images, stale and clearly labelled.
public_view_review.side_view: Raised cover and upper wrist/link6 are visible and close in projection; RGB cannot certify their3D clearance or signed collision separation.
public_view_review.wrist_view: Shows grasped vessel and lower chamber; link6 and high cover contact region are outside its useful field of view. Historical wrist images do not reveal that whole-arm gap.

offline_contact_side_projection.scope: Uses actual later collision world point projected through fixed D24 side camera; not a point supplied to policy and not same-time rendered pixel/visibility certification.

public_view_review.restriction: World contact points, mesh distances and object truth are offline diagnostics only; none was supplied to policy.

comparison_to_GPT03.scope: Shared general whole-robot obstacle-clearance problem, different link/shape/height and changed camera/prompt; no claim of identical collision cause.

limitations: Callback force fields are simulation interface quantities, not calibrated real force measurements; the large value is retained without a physical magnitude conclusion.

Callback points/separation and after-step q/FK are different solver-time views; their surface distances need not equal raw separation. Input SAT crossings do not establish exact native collision onset.
All robot geometry here is authored-input/FK reconstruction; finger declared convex-decomposition and actual attached cooked surfaces are not read back.
P6 requested entry/near-bottom100µm observation cadence was never exercised: collision occurred during world+X transport; no P6 contact-policy success or failure-compliance inference.
Original SAFETY_COLLISION/taskfalse/record valid/physics true preserved. Firstbody>200µm occurs after collision, not evidence of preimpact grasp failure.
No counterfactual path/IK/reset/physics/API/render/training or active teacher data read; a deterministic same-prefix physical check remains separate future work.
